source_metadata.title: Infectious Diseases Society of America 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections

included: Metadata, abstract, methods, introduction, general management suggestions, empiric-therapy considerations, duration/oral-transition considerations, and disclaimer content occurring on pages 1-4.
Table 1 dosing rows and footnotes visible on pages 5-8.
Table 2 breakpoint cells visible on pages 8-9 only.
excluded: No content from page 10 or later was used to create atoms.
Table 2 continues onto page 10; rows beginning on page 10 were not extracted.
Table 2 footnote definitions that appear on page 10 were not used; affected page-9 cells are tagged unresolved_footnote.
References and supplemental material were not inspected for source claims because they fall outside the requested extraction boundary.

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom MVP is explicitly designed for primary literature, whereas this source is a guidance document. The schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation, dosing_recommendation, or susceptibility_breakpoint atom kind.

Guideline recommendations, dosing rows, and breakpoint cells were therefore serialized conservatively as atom_kind=other or author_conclusion rather than being forced into primary-study result structures.

Background burden estimates on page 2 are secondary reports cited by the guidance; they were retained as atom_kind=other with secondary_report tags and were not represented as primary quantitative-result atoms.
No missing study population, exposure, outcome, denominator, or effect-estimate fields were invented to satisfy primary-study-oriented atom kinds.
All atoms are marked needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model and has not been independently human-verified.
